H. Self-Test Procedure

This game will test itself and provide data to show that the game’s circuitry and controls are operating Properly. The data is provided on the video display and speaker. No additional equipment is necessary.
We suggest you perform the self-test procedure when you first set up the game, any time you collect money from the game, when you change game options, or when you suspect game failure.

Refer to Figure 1-3 for the location of the self-test switch and option switches. To perform the self-test, set the self-test switch to on. After about eight seconds the self-test screen will be displayed.

To see game statistics, press the utility coin switch. To reset the high score table, simultaneously push and hold the pump and utility coin switches for 10 seconds. To end the self-test, set the self-test switch to off.
The complete self-test procedure is explained in Chapter 2, Self-Test Procedure. If any part of the test described in Figure 1-4 fails, refer to Chapter 2.
